title: [Decision] Selection-bar actions cannot be configured in Studio: should the view panel offer them?
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「studio没有操作类型的元数据吗？除了批量操作，别的也需要配置的呀。」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## The question

The platform needs no kernel work for bulk changes: a view's `bulkActionDefs` already produced 批量修改负责人 with no code (#30079). But that declaration can be written only in metadata. Should the person configuring a list in Studio be able to add one?

Governing text: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:3576-3593` (`rowActions`, `bulkActions`, `bulkActionDefs`). `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx:1187-1190`: "Selection placement is declared on the LIST VIEW". #30079: no kernel feature.

## Measured

- An action's editor offers five placements and no selection-bar placement. An update action is not offered 列表工具栏, by design.
- Neither Studio view panel shows `bulkActions`, `bulkActionDefs` or `rowActions`: no such section on `surface=view:…` (Basics, Columns & filters, Table options, End-user controls, Navigation & sharing) and none on the object leaf's panel. There are no such keys in `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`.
- So the action editor's note tells a person to declare it on the view, and the view editor has nowhere to do that.

## Options

- **A. A 批量操作 section in the view panel:** pick existing actions for the selection bar (`bulkActions`) and add a field update (`bulkActionDefs`: label, fields to ask, confirmation). The same section works on a customized view of an installed app.
- **B. Picking existing actions only:** a field update still needs metadata.
- **C. Leave it to metadata:** developers and AI only.

## Recommendation: A

## 四轴分析

**实际业务需求。** 哪些字段值得批量改，每个业务不一样：销售改负责人，工单改优先级。这是实施和运营配应用时的常规工作，今天只能找开发。

**项目长远合理性。** 这正符合你的意思：能力留在元数据，内核不写死任何业务字段。A 只是给已有的声明加编辑入口。动作编辑器已经在提示「到视图上声明」，补上后才前后一致。

**防 AI 写错。** 不新增键。编辑器按 spec 校验，字段和选项可以选，比手写更不容易错；声明后默认的删除会不会消失这类隐含行为，也要在界面上讲清楚。

**创业阶段不扩散。** 只加界面，服务端和 spec 不动。范围中等，可以排在 #30059 和页面、数据集入口之后。

| 棱 | A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 业务 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 长远 | 强 | 中 | 中 |
| 防错 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 不扩散 | 中 | 强 | 强 |

## Not measured

Whether the default 删除 leaving the bar when a view declares `bulkActionDefs` is intended, and how a customized view of an installed app merges these keys beyond the one case tested.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "bulkActionDefs" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`
